title: Q9
description:
Read: Lev 16:2, Lev 16:12-13, Exo 25:17-22

The meeting place is between the cherubim, over the mercy seat. He lives on that day only because of the cloud of incense and the blood.

a) Boldness at a throne of grace: what is that throne if this is the place of meeting, and what made the earlier coming the opposite of bold?
